  SELECT DISTINCT store_id
  FROM dim_store

WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id
  FROM dim_store
  WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2025-04-28'
    AND valid_to >= DATE '2025-05-25'
    AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-05-04'
    AND valid_to >= DATE '2026-05-31'
),
fy25_26_p1 AS (
  SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year,
         1 AS period,
         SUM(COALESCE(f.net_amount, 0)) as gross_sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as returns,
         SUM(COALESCE(f.net_amount, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON s.store_id = lfl.store_id
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    AND r.return_date >= DATE '2025-04-28'
    AND r.return_date <= DATE '2025-05-25'
  WHERE f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-04-28'
    AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-05-25'
    AND s.store_id < 900
),
fy26_27_p1 AS (
  SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
         1 AS period,
         SUM(COALESCE(f.net_amount, 0)) as gross_sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as returns,
         SUM(COALESCE(f.net_amount, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net, 0)) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON s.store_id = lfl.store_id
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    AND r.return_date >= DATE '2026-05-04'
    AND r.return_date <= DATE '2026-05-31'
  WHERE f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-05-04'
    AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-05-31'
    AND s.store_id < 900
)
